text:
Alex Park: Quick sync — planning joint GPU perf/W + throughput benchmark with Aurora Hardware. Goals: perf per watt curve, steady throughput, kernel tuning delta. Propose dry run Tue morning, long run Wed.
Maria Lopez: SGTM. I'll own the test matrix and mapping to our runtime profiles + quant presets. Need partner HW SKU list and firmware/driver versions.
Kevin Chen: Asking eng-infra for isolated pools and power-meter availability. Prefer air-gapped nodes for reproducibility — can we reserve a rack? @eng-infra
Samira Patel: Partner update: they can bring two racks: 2x A100 (dual-host) and 8x A100 (dense) — firmware 6.2, driver 535.3. They request a 2h dry-run then a 24h steady-state run. NDA in place.
Jen O'Neil: Telemetry checklist: gpu_power_w, host_power_w (PDUs), p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, KV cache hit%, GPU temp, SM util, kernel build hash, model checksum. Also note ambient temp.
Alex Park: Minimal dry-run matrix suggestion:
```
models: rwd-3b, rwd-13b
seq_len: 512, 1024
quant: fp16, int8
batch_size: 1, 8
kernels: baseline, tuned-v2
```
Samira Patel: Fine. For long run add: sustained tokens/sec targets (50k, 200k), burst patterns, and a warmup phase. Partner asks that numbers stay embargoed until we agree on messaging.
Maria Lopez: I'll mark high-priority combos and flag OOM-risk configs. Will also include expected memory footprints so we can warn partner ahead of time.
Kevin Chen: Infra can provision 8h Tue (prep + dry) and 36h Wed. We'll ship an instrumented image with nvidia-smi + telegraf + perf counters. Need a contact for on-rack PDU hookups and meter calibration.
Alex Park: Samira — please DM the on-site contact and whether partner team will allow us to build repro kernels (we might need symbol access).
Samira Patel: DM incoming. They are open to repro builds but require an engineer-level addendum for driver debug symbols. I'll coordinate signatures.
Jen O'Neil: Data flow: export raw logs + perf counters to s3://redwood-partner-bench/<run_ts>/, retention 90d. I'll create a console dashboard template with perf/W curve and heatmaps per SKU. Also produce a short one-pager for PM/marketing review.
NVIDIA Bot: [automated] Build job queued for benchmark image. ETA: 36h.
Alex Park: Action items: Maria produce matrix by EOD Thu, Kevin reserve nodes and image, Samira share contact + addendum, Jen prepare dashboard stub. Standup Mon 9:30 PT to finalize. :thumbsup:
Kevin Chen: ack, reserving and will post reservation id.
Maria Lopez: ack, CSV + priority viz by EOD Thu.
Samira Patel: ack, will share contact and addendum later today.
Jen O'Neil: ack, dashboard stub by Mon 8am PT.
Alex Park: Great — keeping the thread here for run notes. :rocket:
